name: Vosegus

attributes.attribute: wildwood god honored in the Vosges range

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Vosegus is a Continental Celtic god. He is known only through Roman-era inscriptions and sculptures. Believers read him as the forest spirit of the Vosges heights in eastern France, a range that still carries his name.

okr.objective: Present Vosegus as a Continental Celtic wildwood god of the Vosges range.
key_results: He is known only from Roman-era inscriptions and sculptures.
He was regarded as the wildwood god of the Vosges mountains.
The Vosges mountains still bear his name.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
